hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check --fix -q "$f"; uv run ruff format -q "$f";; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; hits=$(grep -rnE --include='*.py' '^from mlx_vlm|^import mlx_vlm|^from mlx\.|^import mlx\b' nmv/ app_pages/ streamlit_app.py) || exit 0; printf 'Module-scope MLX import detected. CLAUDE.md invariant: mlx-vlm is imported only inside worker functions, never at module scope (mlx_vlm binds its generation_stream to the importing thread; Streamlit reruns on a fresh thread). Move the import into the function body.\n%s\n' "$hits" >&2; exit 2
